t: 阿塔纳修斯被选为亚历山大牧首.
te: Athanasius is elected Patriarch of Alexandria.
dz: 阿塔纳修斯被选为亚历山大牧首.
de: Athanasius is elected Patriarch of Alexandria.

te: The official opening of Constantine's Bridge built over the Danube between Sucidava (Corabia, Romania) and Oescus (Gige…
dz: 由罗马建筑师特奥菲卢斯·帕特里西乌斯(英语:Theophilus Patricius)在苏西达瓦(罗马尼亚科拉比亚)和奥埃斯克斯(保加利亚吉根)之间建造的多瑙河上正式开通.
de: The official opening of Constantine's Bridge built over the Danube between Sucidava (Corabia, Romania) and Oescus (Gigen, Bulgaria) by the Roman architect Theophilus Patricius.
